summary: registry.redhat.io needs authentication: check with podman login --get-login registry.redhat.io and log in with podman login; log in before launching VS Code for the devtools container, and inside the devcontainer to pull EEs.
questions: How do I log in to registry.redhat.io?
Why can't VS Code pull the devtools container?
Check whether I am logged in to the Red Hat registry

answer_card.title: Log in to registry.redhat.io
answer_card.answer_md:
```
podman login --get-login registry.redhat.io   # shows your login if already logged in
podman login registry.redhat.io               # Customer Portal username and password
```

Log in before starting VS Code so it can pull the devtools container, and log in again from a terminal inside the devcontainer to pull execution environments.
